Tel Aviv? The Dead Sea? A hike in the Golan? All three?

Right now, planning an Israel trip means scrolling review sites, zooming around Google Maps, and asking friends who went once years ago. It takes hours — and most of what you find doesn't account for the fact that you're travelling with kids, have three days, or have never been to Israel before.

HOW ISRAPICK WORKS

Three short steps, one clear answer.

01

Answer

A short questionnaire — who you're travelling with, what you like, how much time you have, and whether you want calm or full-on adventure.

02

Match

Your answers are compared against a curated shortlist of Israel's best spots — from desert craters to old port cities — to find the strongest fit.

03

Discover

Get one personal recommendation with a clear reason why, plus two solid alternatives. Didn't land right? Hit restart and answer again.
